verses.text: How dark the gold has become, [How] the pure gold has changed! The sacred stones are poured out At the corner of every street.
verses.textZh: 黃金何其失光！純金何其變色！聖所的石頭倒在各市口上。

verses.text: The precious sons of Zion, Weighed against fine gold, How they are regarded as earthen jars, The work of a potter's hands!
verses.textZh: 錫安寶貴的眾子好比精金，現在何竟算為窯匠手所做的瓦瓶？

verses.text: Even jackals offer the breast, They nurse their young; [But] the daughter of my people has become cruel Like ostriches in the wilderness.
verses.textZh: 野狗尚且把奶乳哺其子，我民的婦人倒成為殘忍，好像曠野的鴕鳥一般。

verses.text: The tongue of the infant cleaves To the roof of its mouth because of thirst; The little ones ask for bread, [But] no one breaks [it] for them.
verses.textZh: 吃奶孩子的舌頭因乾渴貼住上膛；孩童求餅，無人擘給他們。

verses.text: Those who ate delicacies Are desolate in the streets; Those reared in purple Embrace ash pits.
verses.textZh: 素來吃美好食物的，現今在街上變為孤寒；素來臥朱紅褥子的，現今躺臥糞堆。

verses.text: For the iniquity of the daughter of my people Is greater than the sin of Sodom, Which was overthrown as in a moment, And no hands were turned toward her.
verses.textZh: 都因我眾民的罪孽比所多瑪的罪還大；所多瑪雖然無人加手於他，還是轉眼之間被傾覆。

verses.text: Her consecrated ones were purer than snow, They were whiter than milk; They were more ruddy [in] body than corals, Their polishing [was like] lapis lazuli.
verses.textZh: 錫安的貴冑素來比雪純淨，比奶更白；他們的身體比紅寶玉（或譯：珊瑚）更紅，像光潤的藍寶石一樣。

verses.text: Their appearance is blacker than soot, They are not recognized in the streets; Their skin is shriveled on their bones, It is withered, it has become like wood.
verses.textZh: 現在他們的面貌比煤炭更黑，以致在街上無人認識；他們的皮膚緊貼骨頭，枯乾如同槁木。

verses.text: Better are those slain with the sword Than those slain with hunger; For they pine away, being stricken For lack of the fruits of the field.
verses.textZh: 餓死的不如被刀殺的，因為這是缺了田間的土產，就身體衰弱，漸漸消滅。

verses.text: The hands of compassionate women Boiled their own children; They became food for them Because of the destruction of the daughter of my people.
verses.textZh: 慈悲的婦人，當我眾民被毀滅的時候，親手煮自己的兒女作為食物。

verses.text: The LORD has accomplished His wrath, He has poured out His fierce anger; And He has kindled a fire in Zion Which has consumed its foundations.
verses.textZh: 耶和華發怒成就他所定的，倒出他的烈怒；在錫安使火著起，燒燬錫安的根基。

verses.text: The kings of the earth did not believe, Nor [did] any of the inhabitants of the world, That the adversary and the enemy Could enter the gates of Jerusalem.
verses.textZh: 地上的君王和世上的居民都不信敵人和仇敵能進耶路撒冷的城門。

verses.text: Because of the sins of her prophets [And] the iniquities of her priests, Who have shed in her midst The blood of the righteous;
verses.textZh: 這都因他先知的罪惡和祭司的罪孽；他們在城中流了義人的血。

verses.text: They wandered, blind, in the streets; They were defiled with blood So that no one could touch their garments.
verses.textZh: 他們在街上如瞎子亂走，又被血玷污，以致人不能摸他們的衣服。

verses.text: 'Depart! Unclean!' they cried of themselves. 'Depart, depart, do not touch!' So they fled and wandered; [Men] among the nations said, 'They shall not continue to dwell [with us].'
verses.textZh: 人向他們喊著說：！不潔淨的，躲開，躲開！不要挨近我！他們逃走飄流的時候，列國中有人說：他們不可仍在這裡寄居。

verses.text: The presence of the LORD has scattered them, He will not continue to regard them; They did not honor the priests, They did not favor the elders.
verses.textZh: 耶和華發怒，將他們分散，不再眷顧他們；人不重看祭司，也不厚待長老。

verses.text: Yet our eyes failed, [Looking] for help was useless; In our watching we have watched For a nation that could not save.
verses.textZh: 我們仰望人來幫助，以致眼目失明，還是枉然；我們所盼望的，竟盼望一個不能救人的國！

verses.text: They hunted our steps So that we could not walk in our streets; Our end drew near, Our days were finished For our end had come.
verses.textZh: 仇敵追趕我們的腳步像打獵的，以致我們不敢在自己的街上行走。我們的結局臨近；我們的日子滿足；我們的結局來到了。

verses.text: Our pursuers were swifter Than the eagles of the sky; They chased us on the mountains, They waited in ambush for us in the wilderness.
verses.textZh: 追趕我們的比空中的鷹更快；他們在山上追逼我們，在曠野埋伏，等候我們。

verses.text: The breath of our nostrils, the LORD'S anointed, Was captured in their pits, Of whom we had said, 'Under his shadow We shall live among the nations.'
verses.textZh: 耶和華的受膏者好比我們鼻中的氣，在他們的坑中被捉住；我們曾論到他說：我們必在他蔭下，在列國中存活。

verses.text: Rejoice and be glad, O daughter of Edom, Who dwells in the land of Uz; [But] the cup will come around to you as well, You will become drunk and make yourself naked.
verses.textZh: 住烏斯地的以東民哪，只管歡喜快樂；苦杯也必傳到你那裡；你必喝醉，以致露體。

verses.text: [The punishment] of your iniquity has been completed, O daughter of Zion; He will exile you no longer. [But] He will punish your iniquity, O daughter of Edom; He will expose your sins!
verses.textZh: 錫安的民哪，你罪孽的刑罰受足了，耶和華必不使你再被擄去。以東的民哪，他必追討你的罪孽，顯露你的罪惡。
